name: FSSAI hygiene rating directory (old portal)
covers: Establishments that applied for and received an FSSAI hygiene rating. Voluntary, so most restaurants are not listed.

name: FoSCoS licence register
covers: Licence status and validity, looked up only for licence numbers already in our data.

name: Maharashtra FDA press notes
covers: Enforcement actions the FDA chose to announce. Most actions are never announced.

name: eCourts and e-Jagriti
covers: Prosecutions and consumer commission orders, entered by hand when found.

name: FSSAI press releases
covers: Brand-level actions announced by FSSAI, entered by hand.

name: RTI replies from District Designated Officers
covers: Section 32 improvement notices and Section 68 adjudication orders. These are not published online.
